stories.headline: US and China launch talks on AI guardrails
stories.summary: US and Chinese economic chiefs meet Sunday on AI safeguards, tariffs and critical minerals before a Trump–Xi summit. Analysts expect incremental deals, not a breakthrough; no AI agreement has been announced.

stories.headline: Ukraine launches largest drone attack on Moscow
stories.summary: Russian officials said Ukraine launched the largest drone attack yet on Moscow, killing two in the region and damaging an oil-refinery facility as voting ended. Kyiv had not commented, and Reuters could not verify all official claims.

stories.headline: UN gathering opens amid wars and AI concerns
stories.summary: Nearly 130 heads of state gather in New York with the Middle East, Ukraine and AI risks high on the agenda. The UN also faces funding pressure and a leadership transition; major diplomatic breakthroughs remain uncertain.

stories.headline: Houthi attacks unsettle Saudi and Gulf markets
stories.summary: Saudi and Gulf stocks fell after Houthis claimed missile and drone attacks on Riyadh. Smoke was seen near the main airport, but the full damage and effectiveness of the attacks remain unclear.

stories.headline: US says Caribbean vessel strike killed four
stories.summary: US Southern Command said a strike killed four people aboard a vessel allegedly engaged in drug trafficking. It provided limited evidence; rights groups call the broader campaign extrajudicial killings.
